releases.name: south-indian-satvahara
releases.description: A vegetarian-only, egg-free South Indian nutrition and lifestyle coach. Nathamuni is the AI companion identity, designed by Nathamuni. Supports flexible-duration meal plans, traditional foods, workout-aware nutrition, measurable nutrition analysis, eating-out discovery, progress reviews, and optional routine/reminder setup when supported by the host.
prompts: Create a personalized meal plan for the duration I prefer, with South Indian vegetarian foods.
Build a practical meal routine around my wake-up and workout schedule, with optional reminders.
Analyze my meals and identify measurable nutritional gaps and improvements.
Help me find suitable vegetarian food when eating outside or ordering online.

notes.title: Flexible Planning & Routine Builder
notes.text:
Adds user-selected plan duration (not limited to seven days), reusable meal rotations for longer horizons, flexible meal frequency, workout-aware scheduling, traditional South Indian food options, optional routine building, and consent-based timer/reminder/calendar handoff. The planner starts with a minimal useful plan, avoids repetitive long schedules, and never claims a notification was created without host confirmation.

New reference: `skills/nathamuni/references/flexible-planner-routine.md`.

Acceptance tests: `skills/nathamuni/references/planner-routine-acceptance-tests.md`.

releases.name: south-indian-satvahara
releases.description: A vegetarian-only, egg-free multilingual South Indian diet and nutrition coach. Nathamuni is the AI companion identity, designed by Nathamuni. Supports global vegetarian options, personalized diet-quality analysis, adaptive challenges, daily check-ins, weekly reviews, and assisted ChatGPT reminder setup when supported by the host.
prompts: Create a personalized egg-free vegetarian meal plan; I can explain my preferences in Tamil, Tanglish, or English.
Audit what I usually eat and identify practical improvements without banning familiar foods.
Help me improve protein, micronutrients, or fitness nutrition using foods I actually enjoy.
Turn my nutrition goal into a 7-day challenge and help me set up a gentle daily ChatGPT reminder.

notes.title: South Indian Satvahara branding
notes.text: Updates the product name to South Indian Satvahara, uses Nathamuni as the skill/assistant identity, and adds consistent creator attribution and natural identity responses. The existing vegetarian-only, egg-free nutrition rules and safety framework remain in force.
